name: opendexter
description: Give Codex a governed Dexter Wallet for service discovery, bounded purchases, wallet reads, and portfolio visibility.

interface.shortDescription: Your governed Dexter Wallet inside Codex.
interface.longDescription:
OpenDexter connects Codex to the user's passkey-controlled Dexter Wallet. It discovers services, inspects exact current terms, reads the wallet and governed portfolio bound to the authenticated session, and makes only a specifically prepared purchase under the user's limits.

The public product exposes six model-facing tools. Route protocols such as x402 or MPP and funding modes such as Direct Exact, Native Tab, Gateway cash, or Gateway credit are transaction metadata, not separate wallet identities. Older compatibility endpoints remain app-only for a dated transition and are not model routes.

Protected tools use native MCP OAuth. Wallet keys, passkey material, bearer tokens, and one-time codes never belong in the conversation. Ambiguous or post-dispatch purchase results are never retried automatically.
